atoms.name: Uninformed vs informed
atoms.one_line: Uninformed search sees only the problem definition (states, actions, goal test, step cost); informed search also uses $h(n)$.

atoms.name: Frontier data structures
atoms.one_line: BFS: FIFO queue. DFS: LIFO stack. UCS: priority queue on $g(n)$.

atoms.name: Expansion order, ties, graph vs tree search
atoms.one_line: Fix the tie-break, then simulate the frontier; goal test on removal; an explored set stops repeats.

atoms.name: Uniform-cost search
atoms.one_line: Expand the lowest $g(n)$; optimal for positive costs; cheaper paths can replace frontier entries.

atoms.name: Depth-limited and iterative deepening
atoms.one_line: DLS returns cutoff at limit $\ell$; IDS repeats DLS with $\ell=0,1,2,\dots$ and finds a shallowest goal.

atoms.name: Completeness and optimality
atoms.one_line: BFS: complete, optimal for equal costs. DFS: neither. UCS: both if costs $\ge\varepsilon>0$. IDS: like BFS.

atoms.name: Time and space in b, d, m
atoms.one_line: BFS $O(b^d)$ and $O(b^d)$; DFS $O(b^m)$ and $O(bm)$; IDS $O(b^d)$ and $O(bd)$.

atoms.name: Bidirectional search
atoms.one_line: Two searches meet in the middle: $O(b^{d/2})$ each; needs predecessors and a known goal.

patterns.name: Place a method as uninformed or informed
Compare BFS and DFS expansion counts on a numbered state space
